summary: Tests-only red-phase PR for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with a generated OpenAPI Swift client). Added 3 permanent Swift test files under iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/ plus a test-plan/delta doc. Layer-1 tests (package deps + vendored spec contract) compile and run today and fail for exactly the missing deliverables; Layer-2 stubbed-response tests are canImport-gated and skip until the ColorMatchingOpenAPI generated target exists, and were proven green (7/7) plus the spec-contract suite (19/19) in a reference scratch harness on Linux Swift 6.1.2 against a real swift-openapi-generator 1.13.1 client. Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published viamin/color_matching spec are recorded in docs/openapi-generated-client-test-plan.md.
